subject: Mutual action plan and security deliverables for Acme Financial
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-fin.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@acme-fin.com>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP + security artifacts for evaluation

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — team at Acme is ready to move into an evaluation window. Before we lock dates, our security and procurement teams need a mutual action plan that lays out the security/compliance gates and a proposed close timeline. Specifically we need: SOC 2 Type II report (or summary), completed SIG/CAIQ answers (or status), a copy of your DPA, and confirmation of data retention policies (logs, backups, snapshots).

Can you share a MAP with milestones that align to our evaluation (2-week POC + 1-week security review)? Our ideal close date target is 2026-04-01 but procurement may push if any docs require legal review.

Also CC'ing Carlos (security) and procurement.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Security Programs — Acme Financial
elena@acme-fin.com

Attachments: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@acme-fin.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + security artifacts for evaluation

Elena — great to hear, excited to partner. I put together a draft MAP and attached the spreadsheet (MAP_ACME_20260315.xlsx) with milestones, owners, and expected artifacts. High level:

- Week 0 (this week): Handover + kickoff (we share SOC2 summary + SIG answers + draft DPA) — owner: Karthik
- Week 1-2: POC evaluation (engineering access, example dataset, perf/latency tests) — owner: Vivek
- Week 2-3: Security review (Acme reviews SIG+evidence; Redwood provides evidence index) — owner: Lauren
- Week 3: Contract & DPA finalization, procurement sign-off — owner: Monica
- Week 4: Go/no-go and onboarding window starts if signed

Quick notes on the artifacts attached/included:
- Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (high-level overview; full report available under NDA)
- SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx (completed answers for commonly requested controls; evidence pointers in index)
- Redwood-DPA-v3.docx (our standard DPA draft)
- SOC2-evidence-index.txt (mapping of SIG questions to evidence artifacts)

Data retention summary (short):
- Token / request logs: default 90 days; can extend on Dedicated installs or via S3 archive for >90 days (customer-managed)
- Model caches & KV: ephemeral, flushed per deployment policy; persisted KV backups are retained for up to 7 years in our backup store for audit purposes unless explicitly configured shorter in Dedicated/Private setups
- Backups & snapshots: encrypted at rest; 7-year retention default for enterprise customers unless contract specifies otherwise

Can you confirm Acme's security review target date and whether you need full SOC2 report under NDA? I can also schedule a 30-min walkthrough of the SIG answers with Carlos next week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_ACME_20260315.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx, Redwood-DPA-v3.docx, SOC2-evidence-index.txt

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: internal - Acme MAP and evidence handoff

Folks — looping in for quick review of the MAP and evidence index before I share the evidence bundle with Acme. A few internal asks:

- Vivek: can you confirm which log types we can redact vs. which are required for SOC-related evidence? Elena asked about "token logs" — we default to 90 days but security may want 12 months of auth logs depending on their risk policy. Need to know how fast we can expose longer retention and any ops cost implication.
- Monica: procurement will likely push redlines on the DPA. Recommend we prepare an editable DPA + a short redline playbook that explains our acceptable changes.
- Karthik: I'll prepare an evidence package skeleton for the SIG answers. Please review the mapping in SOC2-evidence-index.txt and confirm owner for each evidence file.

I'll hold sending anything external until we confirm retention options and Vivek signs off.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Legal — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-index.txt

From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-fin.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@acme-fin.com>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + security artifacts for evaluation

Karthik / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. A few clarifications from Acme security and procurement:

- Security: we reviewed the SIG snapshot and the evidence index. We need a short walkthrough on the SIG responses — Carlos is available Tue 17th at 10:00 PT. We also need confirmation that authentication logs (login, API key usage) will be retained for at least 12 months in a searchable format for incident investigations. If Redwood cannot provide 12 months by default, please confirm a path (e.g., S3 export + retention policy).
- Procurement: DPA redlines: we will prepare an initial markup and share by Monday. We would also prefer to receive the SOC2 report under NDA; please send the report or a secure access link and the process for NDA execution.

Proposed schedule given our internal calendar:
- 17 Mar: SIG walkthrough (Carlos)
- 18–24 Mar: Acme security review & DPA redline submission
- 25–30 Mar: Redwood responds to redlines and provides SOC2 under NDA
- Target sign: 01 Apr (stretch)

If that looks reasonable we will start the procurement loop.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@acme-fin.com>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + security artifacts for evaluation — confirmation & next steps

Elena / team — thanks, that plan works. Quick confirmation and next steps from Redwood:

1) SIG walkthrough scheduled: Tue 17 Mar 10:00 PT (inv sent separately). Carlos, meeting invite includes SIG sheet and evidence mapping.
2) SOC2 access: we'll provide the SOC2 Type II report under NDA. I attached a summary and an evidence index; for the full report we will send a secure link once NDA is executed (please send your standard NDA or we can use our mutual NDA).
3) Retention options:
   - Authentication & API usage logs: default 90 days for Hosted accounts; we can export continuous logs to a customer S3 bucket for 12+ months retention (costs billed to customer). On Dedicated or Private deployments, retention is customer-controlled and we will document the configuration steps in the onboarding runbook.
   - Backups & snapshots: default 7-year retention for enterprise contracts; we can shorten/extend by contract.

4) DPA: Monica will track redlines and prepare responses. Monica, once Acme sends the markup we will return a redline + commentary within 3 business days.

5) MAP update: I updated the MAP with concrete dates tied to the timeline Elena proposed and attached updated MAP_ACME_20260315.xlsx. Key milestone owners are in the sheet.

6) DocuSign: we can put the final SOW/DPA in DocuSign once terms are agreed. Draft envelope ready: https://docusign.com/recipient/view?envelopeId=ABC123

If procurement sends their redlines by Monday, our target to provide SOC2 under NDA and redline responses by 25 Mar is realistic. We will treat this as a priority for the week.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_ACME_20260315.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-index.txt
